SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT. All people and places are fictional. Not a legal record.
SALE DEED
This Sale Deed is executed on 05/08/2009 at Harinagar, Uttar Pradesh.
Date of Execution: 05/08/2009
BETWEEN Shri Suresh Prasad Gupta, S/o Late Shyam Lal Verma, R/o 44 Gandhi Marg,
Harinagar (hereinafter called the "VENDOR")
AND Shri Ramesh Chandra Verma, S/o Late Shyam Lal Verma, R/o 44 Gandhi Marg, Harinagar
(hereinafter called the "VENDEE").
RECITALS
The Vendor purchased the said property from Kailash Nath Mishra by a registered sale deed
dated 20/01/1996, registered as Document No. 118/1996, and has been in peaceful possession
since.
The Vendor has agreed to sell the property described below for a total sale consideration of Rs.
12,00,000/- (Rupees in full), received by bank transfer.
Stamp duty of Rs. 84,000/- has been paid through e-stamp certificate.
SCHEDULE OF PROPERTY
Property Address: Plot No. 17, Block C, Lakshmi Nagar Extension, Tehsil Sadar, District
Harinagar.
Khasra No. 245/2, Khata No. 118, total area 200 sq. yards.
Boundaries of the property:
North: 30 feet wide road
South: Plot No. 18 of Mohan Lal
East: Plot No. 16
West: Community Park
COVENANTS
The Vendor has this day delivered vacant possession of the property to the Vendee.
The Vendor declares the property is free from all encumbrances, charges and mortgages.
REGISTRATION DETAILS
Registered at the Office of the Sub-Registrar Harinagar-II. Document No. 3341/2009, Book No.
1, Volume No. 2088, Pages 45 to 60.
Date of Registration: 05/08/2009
Signed by the Vendor and the Vendee in the presence of witnesses.
